description: Personal wiki and memory for AI assistants: store, search, and recall structured notes.

cmd.description: Run in stdio transport mode (required for MCP clients like Claude Desktop)
cmd.name: BRAINS_TRANSPORT

name: io.github.spacecowboyian/brains

environmentVariables.description: Path to local wiki directory (used when STORAGE_BACKEND=local or omitted)
environmentVariables.name: WIKI_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client ID (required for Google Drive backend)
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth client secret (required for Google Drive backend)
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth refresh token (required for Google Drive backend)
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Google Drive folder ID for wiki storage
environmentVariables.name: DRIVE_FOLDER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Supabase project URL (required for Supabase backend)
environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Supabase service role key (required for Supabase backend)
environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY

runtimeArguments.description: Run in stdio transport mode (required for MCP clients like Claude Desktop)
runtimeArguments.name: BRAINS_TRANSPORT
